Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Gameplay 3 End of the game 4 Fruit cards 4.1 Set Fruits 4.2 Majority Fruits 4.3 Joker 5 Toucan cards 5.1 Gift Toucan 5.2 Steal Toucan 5.3 Flip Toucan 6 Game Components Overview Will you be the most discerning bird? The tropical forest is full of tasty fruits, but be careful: some may not actually be that good for you … Harvest the best fruits and use toucan cards wisely to protect your collection… or to steal from your opponents! Once the draw pile is empty, count up the points from your collected cards and whoever has the most wins the game. Gameplay On your turn, pick 1 column and take all of its cards. Place the cards face up in front of you. Toucan cards give the players access to special abilities. If you take a toucan card, use its effect immediately and discard it afterwards. If you take 2 or more toucan cards, use their effects in the order of your choice. ( Note: you'll only find toucans in the second half of the draw pile ) The turn ends with adding one card to each column from the draw pile. End of the game Play until there is only 1 column left on the table ( Note: every player plays the same number of turns ). Discard the remaining column of cards. Count up the points from collected fruit cards. The player with the most points wins the game. Fruit cards Set Fruits The points you win for each set of fruit cards depend on the number of cards collected, as indicated on the pictogram. The number of card piles shown on each fruit card corresponds to the total number of cards of this fruit in the game. Majority Fruits You win points per card depending on who has the most cards for each of these fruits. If a player has more of these fruit cards than anyone else, they score the higher point total per card. If not they score the lower point total per card. In the event of a tie all players score the lower point value per card. Joker There is 1 joker card. At the end of the game, you can decide which fruit cards set you add it to. It will count as one of those fruits. You can't add it to a complete set. Toucan cards There are 3 types of toucan cards. Toucans have special abilities. When you take one, use it immediately, then discard it and continue the game as usual. If you cannot use the effect, discard the card without using the ability. If you have more than 1 toucan card at the same time, use them in the order of your choice. Gift Toucan Give 1 of your face-up cards to another player. Steal Toucan Take a face-up card from another player. Flip Toucan Flip all the fruit cards in front of you and form a single pile, face down. Note: you cannot look at your face-down cards again once they have been flipped. They cannot be given to, or stolen by, another player. [Rating: 1/10] Light set collector combined with some Toucan "power cards" which allow you to give an opponent a card, take a card or protect your cards at the expense of flipping them face down on the table.  + Art was colourful and point values easy to distinguish ± Stealing of cards from opponents may not go over well with kids or some casual gamers - Randomness. Given the choice of card(s) is limited to just three columns there is a huge amount of random draw luck in what cards appear - On your turn decisions seemed pretty obvious at to what column would be best at that time - Too many scoring categories

[Rating: 3/10] [i]Abandon all Toucans in favor of a better Point Salad. Go![/i] Played in: [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/geeklist/301212/item/9220260][u]2022[/u][/url]

[Rating: 3/10] Coloretto without the decision of where to place drawn cards, needlessly fiddlier scoring, too many card types (at least for a two player game), and some steal/donate/protect power cards.

[Rating: 3/10] Online gespielt auf BGA. Nicht richtig verstanden. Einfach Random Karten ausgewählt. Verloren.

[Rating: 4/10] Boardgamearena. Hübsche Grafik, aber ich mag Coloretto / Sushi Go weitaus lieber. Dieses Spiel fühlt sich an wie ein Mix aus beidem. Dabei bilden sich bei Tucano teilweise große Nehm-Stapel, somit fehlen mir taktische Möglichkeiten wenn ein Stapel immer mehr wächst und praktisch nicht mehr genommen wird. Bei der großen Anzahl an verschiedenen Früchten fühlt sich das Merken mehr wie Arbeit an, statt mir Spaß zu machen (wenn man umdrehen muss). Ich bin froh es nicht gekauft zu haben.

[Rating: 4/10] Really not original, I can design this type of game in less than an hour. Many similar games exist, and this one is certainly not the best.

[Rating: 4/10] online play with 2. Probably could use more players, but it is basic set collection for points or negative points. You have three special powers of giving away a card, stealing a card, or hiding your set. Hidden info here doesn't bother me, but set collection for VP's the game isn't compelling for me.

[Rating: 4/10] Deceptively casual. Mostly arbitrary. If you can remember what you have, the correct draw is always obvious. If you can't it could be random. Such a heavy memory reliance is not fun for me when that's not the focus..

[Rating: 4/10] Not a big fan. It's a simple drafting game, which requires more math to determine incentives than it should. Leading to either random play when not doing the math or a slog when you do. The take that cards feel weird in a 3-4 player game, I'm sure they would feel more at home in a 2 player game. The memory element also feels pretty random.
